[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Robert Glasgow was born in Manchester on 19 August 1846 to Robert Glasgow and Elizabeth Wright. He became minister of Invertiel in 1876, resigned in 1914, and died in Portobello on 11 March 1924.<ref>[https://electricscotland.com/bible/fastiecclesiaesc05scot.pdf Hew Scott, Fasti ecclesiae scoticanae, vol. 5, p. 101, Invertiel: Robert Glasgow]</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The directory entries describe the same minister. Edition spans are retained as ranges. The other Robert Glasgow on the Abbotshall memorial was his son, who died in 1915.
